# PhysxVehicleControllerAPI

Driver inputs (throttle, brakes, steer, target gear) of a vehicle that has a drive. The runtime checks that the vehicle [prim](glossary.md#prim) lists it and reads its columns once, when the vehicle is created; PhysxVehicleTankControllerAPI adds thrust inputs on top.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **Requires on the same prim:** [`PhysxVehicleAPI`](PhysxVehicleAPI.md)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `physxVehicleController:accelerator` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0: no throttle. A present value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |
| `physxVehicleController:brake0` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0: braking system brakes0 released. A present value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |
| `physxVehicleController:brake1` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0: braking system brakes1 released. A present value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |
| `physxVehicleController:brake` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0. Deprecated and read only when authored (every present ovstage column counts as authored): a nonzero value logs a deprecation warning, and a value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |
| `physxVehicleController:handbrake` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0. Deprecated and read only when authored (every present ovstage column counts as authored): a nonzero value logs a deprecation warning, and a value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |
| `physxVehicleController:steer` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0: no steer. A present value outside [-1, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |
| `physxVehicleController:steerLeft` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0. Deprecated and read only when authored (every present ovstage column counts as authored): a nonzero value logs a deprecation warning, and a value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |
| `physxVehicleController:steerRight` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0. Deprecated and read only when authored (every present ovstage column counts as authored): a nonzero value logs a deprecation warning, and a value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |
| `physxVehicleController:targetGear` | int32 | none | 255 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 255 | 255: automatic forward gear shifting. A present value other than 255 must lie in [-1, 30] (reverse, neutral, forward gears), otherwise an error is logged and the vehicle is not created. |

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxVehicleAPI`](PhysxVehicleAPI.md):** Read only on a prim that lists PhysxVehicleAPI, after the vehicle passed its other validation. The vehicle must have a drive (physxVehicle:drive, or a drive API on the vehicle prim); otherwise an error is logged and the vehicle is not created.
- **[`PhysxVehicleWheelControllerAPI`](PhysxVehicleWheelControllerAPI.md):** Mutually exclusive: when a wheel attachment of the vehicle lists PhysxVehicleWheelControllerAPI, an error is logged and the vehicle is not created.
- **[`PhysxVehicleTankControllerAPI`](PhysxVehicleTankControllerAPI.md):** When that API is listed too, these columns are read on the tank controller path, which adds physxVehicleTankController:thrust0 and thrust1.

## Notes

- Every column is change-tracked: the runtime applies a new value while simulating; an out-of-range value then logs an error and is ignored instead of invalidating the vehicle.
- On reset the runtime writes the initial controller values back through the data-write sink; an attach without a sink skips that.
